description:
The AVX2 packed $\mathbb{F}_7$ bipedal kernel in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/bipedal_avx2_packed7.rs` has no `vpshufb` 16-byte nibble-lookup path; it uses the generic lane arithmetic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A `vpshufb` nibble-lookup path computes the same results as the current kernel on the shared packed-field suite, with the scalar fallback retained.
- [aspirational] REQ-02: A committed receipt from an uncontended host compares the two paths under the repository's benchmark protocol.
title: AVX2-native nibble-LUT path for the packed F_7 bipedal kernel
